name: opendocs-cc
description: Publish Markdown to shareable links and export branded PDF or Word files, with the OpenDocs.cc MCP server and the OpenDocs skill.

interface.longDescription: OpenDocs.cc turns the Markdown your AI writes into documents people can read and use. Ask it to publish a plan, report or brief and you get a clean link your team can open; publishing again updates the same link and keeps every version. Export any document as a PDF or Word file in your workspace's brand: logo, colors and font. Find and read your documents, edit them, organize them into projects, share them with specific people or a whole email domain, and invite teammates. When the workspace has connected them, save files to its Google Drive folders and send documents for e-signature through DocuSeal. Sign in once with your OpenDocs account. It asks before making a document public or sending anything to other people.
defaultPrompt: Publish this as an OpenDocs document and give me the link.
Export my latest OpenDocs document as a PDF.
Find the launch plan in OpenDocs and summarize it.
